newsitem.title: UK: Coffee group sets up website on the Internet.
newsitem.headline: Coffee group sets up website on the Internet.

text.p: The International Coffee Organisation (ICO) said on Tuesday its Coffeline database, containing 35,000 records, is now available on the Internet.
ICO executive director Celsius Lodder said the database is available through a U.S-based information service known as NlightN, established by the Library Corporation.
Coffeline is a bibliographical database created by the the ICO, containing material identified and processed by the group from the beginning of 1973.
Studies or articles on coffee and relevant to coffee are identified from a range of some 5,000 journals.
The ICO, based in London, groups major coffee producing and consuming countries.
Its Internet address is http,//www.nlightn.com. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
